# Isaiah Chapter 26 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 21 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Strong city; perfect peace; the dead shall live; hide until wrath passes*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Song of Trust:** Strong city; perfect peace; the dead shall live; hide until wrath passes. The key message for modern readers: "You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you"

*-- PNEUMA*
